items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1958-12-22
items.q: He was a great guy... Henry Harden played in that band. Earl Fusche played the saxophone... I know it was good, but everybody was right. It was a good band.

ctx.x: He was a great guy. You see, he was wonderful. And one of the three trumpets, I know that for sure. Henry Harden played in that band. Earl Fusche played the saxophone. Trombone, man. I believe it was Yanko. Anyway, I know it was good, but everybody was right. It was a good band. Black Happy played. That was a good band. Yeah. That's right. Black Happy played. That, mostly he played.
Oh, now one more question sort of puts you on the spot about who your favorite drummers are, or who they were at all times, not just today. Who was about the best drummer you ever heard? Oh, no.
